enforced: Every semantic and component token alias resolves to a real foundation token (extraction/verify_all.py)
Every semantic token is mapped in every theme (extraction/verify_all.py)
Policy category names are real catalog keys (extraction/verify_all.py)
convention: Reference colours via semantic.* or color.*; do not write raw hex values
Use fontSize.* roles; do not invent px sizes
Radius is 0 except the HubSpot replica input

rawValueRestrictions.color: Never write raw hex/rgba; reference color.* or semantic.*
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: Never write raw px/vw; reference fontSize.*
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: sans only (hubspot-replica only inside the footer email form)
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: hairline-* shadows only; no drop shadows

overrides: GAP RECORDED, NOT INVENTED: PageSpec nodes carry no per-instance style or token-override field (node properties are only section, variant, content, motion). Styling is owned entirely by section/component contracts, so there is no PageSpec field to validate token overrides against; adversarial coverage for tokens therefore lives at the catalog/policy layer (extraction/prove_drift.py), not at the PageSpec layer.
